sources.title: Ecco il ponte crollato da più di 2 anni

curation_note.it: L'annale identifica il 2 marzo 2011 come massimo storico della stazione Salinello a Cavatassi: 2,86 m e 231 m³/s pubblicati. La stazione è a valle di Campli; i valori descrivono il colmo sullo stesso fiume, non la sezione del ponte crollato.
curation_note.en: The annal identifies 2 March 2011 as the historical maximum at the Salinello at Cavatassi station: published values of 2.86 m and 231 m³/s. The station is downstream of Campli; the values describe the same-river peak, not the collapsed bridge section.

provenance.method: Manual extraction encoded in the ARCUS event-report curation registry

caveats: The value describes the named official station and is not assigned to the collapsed bridge section.
Sensor readings and post-event topographic surveys retain their distinct evidence types.
The encoded failure process remains separate from hydrometric evidence.
No bridge return period or causal probability is inferred from the basin reference.
